about: The postcommunion of the First Sunday of Advent. It asks that we receive God's mercy within His temple and approach the coming celebrations of our renewal with fitting reverence. Its opening words adapt Psalm 47:10 in the Vulgate numbering (Psalm 48 in Hebrew), and its conclusion is printed as the two words Per Dóminum.

s01.translation: Lord, let us receive Your mercy in the heart of Your temple, so that we may anticipate the coming celebrations of our renewal with fitting reverence. Through the Lord.

w012.function: The future participle agrees with “solémnia” (w013) and presents the solemnities as still to come.

w013.function: The adjective stands substantivally for the coming solemn celebrations of restoration.
